title: Duality ruins what ego keeps defending
summary: This meets the self asking for peace while clinging to divided loyalties. The line says unrest is not accidental; ego and duality keep feeding it.
takeaway: Name the split that keeps peace away.
lifeApplication: When you want peace without giving up the second attachment, name the split honestly. Stop asking for rest while protecting what ruins it.

source.shortMeaning: Ego keeps its unrest alive by loving two masters.
source.lifeApplication: When you want peace, name the second loyalty you are still protecting.

evidence.coreClaim: Ego keeps its unrest alive by loving two masters.
evidence.turn: Ego cannot make peace; Naam and service can.
evidence.practicalImplication: When you want peace without giving up the second attachment, name the split honestly. Stop asking for rest while protecting what ruins it.
